Re-Bedding & Re-Pointing

Crumbling ridge-cap mortar is one of the most common causes of leaks. We strip the old bedding, re-bed the caps and finish with flexible pointing.

  • Old mortar removed & re-bedded
  • Flexible pointing that moves, not cracks
  • Stops leaks at the ridge line
Check my ridge caps →

Metal & Colorbond Roofs

Faded, chalky or lightly rusted metal roofs can usually be restored too — treated, primed and coated instead of stripped and replaced.

  • Rust treatment & priming
  • Screw & sheet repairs
  • Coatings in popular Colorbond colours

How it works

The restoration process

A proper restoration is a system, not a coat of paint. Here's how we take a roof from tired to watertight in five stages.

1

Inspect

We get on the roof, check every tile, cap and flashing, and give you a written quote with honest advice.

2

Clean

A high-pressure clean strips moss, lichen and grime so repairs and coatings bond properly.

3

Repair

Broken tiles are replaced, loose sheets fixed, and any rust, flashing or valley issues sorted.

4

Bed & Point

Ridge caps are re-bedded and finished with flexible pointing, then the surface is primed and sealed.

5

Coat

Premium membrane in your chosen colour, then a final walk-through inspection with you before we pack up.

Good questions

Before you book

Roof restoration or full replacement — which do I need?+

If the roof structure and most tiles or sheets are sound, a restoration is almost always the smarter spend — it typically costs a fraction of a replacement and adds many years of life. If we find serious structural damage during the free inspection, we'll tell you honestly and explain your options.

How long does a restoration take?+

Most homes are completed within two to four days, depending on roof size, the repairs needed and the weather. Your written quote includes a clear schedule before any work starts.

Can I change my roof colour?+

Yes. Our coating systems come in a wide range of colours, including popular Colorbond tones. A colour change is one of the biggest transformations a home can get — we'll help you choose a shade that suits your walls, gutters and street.

Do you work on metal and Colorbond roofs too?+

Yes — tile, terracotta and metal roofs. Faded or lightly rusted metal can usually be treated, primed and coated rather than replaced, which saves a significant amount.

Can I just get a leak fixed?+

Absolutely. Plenty of our work is standalone repairs — a cracked tile, tired pointing or a rusted valley. We fix the cause of the leak, not just the symptom, and let you know if we spot anything else worth attention.

How do I get a quote?+

Inspections and written quotes are free, with no obligation. Call (02) 4944 2085, message us on WhatsApp at 0413 933 110, or send the enquiry form below.
